name: Ferrari F80
description: The ultimate flagship hypercar and successor to LaFerrari. Inspired by Le Mans-winning technology, it blends a motorsport-derived V6 hybrid powertrain with active aerodynamics to generate a mind-blowing 1,200 horsepower.

name: Ferrari SF90 XX Stradale
description: The first road-legal 'XX' program supercar from Maranello. It takes the SF90 platform to extreme limits with aggressive aero, a massive fixed rear wing, and a tuned hybrid V8 producing 1,016 horsepower.

name: Ferrari 12Cilindri
description: A masterpiece paying homage to Ferrari's legendary lineage. It packs a front-mid naturally aspirated 6.5-liter V12 revving up to 9,500 RPM, enclosed in a futuristic design inspired by classic 1960s GTs.

name: Ferrari 296 GTB
description: Redefining fun to drive, the 296 GTB is Ferrari's revolutionary mid-rear engine sports car featuring a mid-mounted 120-degree V6 paired with an electric motor to unleash 819 horsepower.

name: Ferrari Purosangue
description: Ferrari's first-ever four-door, four-seater vehicle. Powered by a roaring 715-horsepower naturally aspirated V12, it combines supercar acceleration with groundbreaking active suspension and daily utility.

name: Ferrari Daytona SP3
description: Part of the ultra-exclusive Icona series, the Daytona SP3 honors 1960s endurance racing prototypes with a breathtaking carbon-fiber mid-engine design and a pure 829-horsepower naturally aspirated V12.
